messages:
pagerduty-bot: Pager duty alert: high error rate from infer-pool-usw-3. Incident triggered (sev-2) — multiple node NotReady events and container restarts. Paging oncall-luca.

oncall-luca: I'm awake, looking. any customer visible impact?

product-support: Reports of 502s and slow responses for a small subset of customers (app-xyz). Error rate +18% in last 5m.

maria_g: I see spikes in pod restarts on nodes gpunode-77..79. kubelet logs show repeated "kubelet: heartbeat lost" followed by restart.

kevin_l: infra-bot, can you dump node statuses and recent events?

infra-bot: Node status summary:
```
NAME           STATUS     RESTARTS   AGE
gpunode-77     NotReady   3          21d
gpunode-78     NotReady   4          19d
gpunode-79     Ready      1          22d
```
Recent events (last 20m):
```
- kubelet: failed to sync pod, rpc error: context deadline exceeded
- kubelet: container runtime not responding
- kernel: NVRM: Xid 79: GPU page fault (possibly cooked) -> driver recover
- docker: OOMKilled inference-runtime pid=2331
```

sophie_r: Xid 79 + OOMKilled on the same machines. Could be runaway batch sizes or KV cache growth. Any config changes deployed recently?

maria_g: No config changes in the last deploy window. We did push a model swap to v2-compact yesterday but that's been stable.

kevin_l: Plan: cordon the two NotReady nodes, scale up a standby pool, and fail open routing to dedicated-pool for affected customers. oncall-luca, can you run cordon/drain on gpunode-77 and 78?

oncall-luca: Starting cordon gpunode-77/78 now. Will drain pods with grace 30s and fallback to instance-level reroute policy.

oncall-luca: Running: `kubectl cordon gpunode-77 && kubectl drain gpunode-77 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

infra-bot: Drain result: some inference pods failed to evict (GPU lock file). Logs attached to pod infer-abc-112: `runtime: cudaDriver lost context`, container restarted 2x during drain.

maria_g: Okay CPU-only fallback? We should push model-quantized variant to dedicated-pool for routed traffic to avoid GPU driver issues.

kevin_l: I'll open a temporary route: set routing policy infer-routing -> prefer dedicated-pool-usw with model v2-quant. Doing `rbac apply` now.

product-support: Notifying customers impacted: app-xyz on degraded performance, ETA for mitigation ~15-25m.

sophie_r: While we do that, let's collect a kernel dump and GPU driver logs for gpunode-77. This smells like driver memory leak + sudden KV cache growth causing OOMs.

maria_g: grabbing dmesg and nvidia-smi -q output.

maria_g: nvidia-smi shows transient ECC errors and high memory usage on process inference-runtime (pid 2331): 94% GPU mem.
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Memory-Usage        : 12128 MiB / 12288 MiB                              |
| Processes           : inference-runtime (pid 2331)                       |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

kevin_l: Good data. Next: increase autoscaler target for dedicated-pool-usw by +3 nodes to absorb traffic. Also create temporary taint: gpu-fault=true:NoSchedule on the two nodes before reboot so they don't accept pods until cleaned.

oncall-luca: Autoscaler bump applied. Taint added to gpunode-77,78. Reboot scheduled after a kernel+driver reinstallation.

infra-bot: New pods are coming up in dedicated-pool-usw, model fallback route active. Error rate for app-xyz down from +18% -> +6% after routing change. Latency still elevated for some requests.

product-support: Sending status update to customers: mitigated, continuing investigation, next update in 30m.

kevin_l: For RCA: collect kubelet logs just before restart, container runtime logs, and driver crash traces. We'll also check recent batch size distribution—maybe a client sent large prompts that exploded KV cache.

sophie_r: Adding temporary throttling rule at LB level: max tokens/req 2048 and max concurrent per-key 8 to reduce pressure while we root cause.

maria_g: Dumping pod metrics for the last hour shows a handful of anomalous requests with token count ~45k in the last 30m — looks like a runaway job hitting KV cache and causing OOMs.

oncall-luca: Confirmed. Kicking off revocable-account ban for the offending API key and invalidating sessions for that key.

kevin_l: Good. Next actions: 1) Reimage gpunode-77/78 with patched driver (NVIDIA 525.x) 2) Run extended kubelet sanity checks 3) Keep routing fallback until nodes stable 4) Prepare postmortem with timeline and offender token examples.

product-support: Customers acknowledged the update and appreciate the fast response. No SLA blips escalated so far.

sophie_r: I'll own follow-up for throttling & token validation improvements. maria_g and kevin_l will coordinate driver/kernel fixes. oncall-luca can close the page when nodes are back to Ready and error-rate < 1% for 15m.

oncall-luca: Will monitor. marking incident in progress and will update when nodes reboot and pass healthchecks. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident annotated: severity remains P2. Links: runbook/inferpool-gpu-driver (internal), incident ticket #INC-2026.

maria_g: Reboot complete on gpunode-77, kernel+driver reinstalled. Node transitions Ready -> kube-proxy checks fine. Starting GPU regression tests.

infra-bot: GPU regression tests passed on gpunode-77. removing taint.

oncall-luca: Node returned to Ready and pods are stable. Observability: error-rate for app-xyz back to baseline (~0.3%). Closing page in 15m if no regressions.

kevin_l: Great work. We'll draft an RCA with timeline, the offending API key trace, and mitigations (throttles, early token-count validation, driver update cadence).

product-support: Preparing external customer note (non-technical) to be sent after RCA review.

sophie_r: Adding follow-up action: alert for long-tail token counts > 10k per req and automatic temporary throttling.

maria_g: Adding logs to incident ticket. will attach dmesg, nvidia-smi outputs, kubelet logs.

oncall-luca: Closing thread for now, will reopen if we see flaps. Thanks team.
